description: Source code for diffcore break operations in a version control system, including functions to determine when to break file pairs based on edit size and to merge broken pairs.

methods.name: should_break
methods.description: Determines whether a pair of files should be broken into delete and create based on edit size and other criteria.

methods.name: diffcore_break
methods.description: Breaks file pairs in the diff queue into delete and create pairs if they meet break criteria.

methods.name: merge_broken
methods.description: Merges two broken file pairs back into a single pair.

methods.name: diffcore_merge_broken
methods.description: Merges broken pairs in the diff queue back together if possible.
